title: Term Life Insurance Repeat Reinstatement Charge
content:
**Fee schedule — Term Life Insurance.** A repeat reinstatement charge is added to the reinstatement amount according to the earlier reinstatement applications on the same policy that were completed within the 60 months ending today — counted from the policy's reinstatement applications marked completed, by their decision dates:

| Earlier reinstatements completed within the 60 months ending today | Charge |
|---|---|
| two or more | 50.00 |
| exactly one | 25.00 |
| none | nothing |

**Hypothetical.** Today 1 August 2026. Earlier reinstatements completed on 3 September 2021 and 10 May 2024: both fall within the 60 months — 50.00. If the first had been completed on 31 July 2021, it would fall outside, leaving one — 25.00.
